user can post one (rate limited); everything else is reserved to the administrators.

CollectionItem-collection.write.description:
A line of the collection of a player: copies of one print of a card (its extension and its rarity) in a given
condition, language and edition. Copies in another condition are another line; a graded card (company, grade,
optional certificate number) has no condition and is a line of its own, one copy per line.

The collection is private unless its owner made it public (User::collectionPublic).

condition.description: Empty for a graded card (its grade tells it).

tradeQuantity.description: How many of the copies are offered for trade (the "doubles"), from 0 to the quantity.

tradeValue.description: What one copy is worth in a trade, in euros (two decimals). Entered by the owner for now.

grade.description: The grade given by the company, from 1 to 10 (half points allowed).

Deck-deck.write.description:
A deck built by a player: a name, an optional game format and its cards by section (main, extra, side).

A deck is private by default; a public deck is readable by everyone unless a moderator hides it. Saving never
requires a valid deck (a deck under construction is fine): the rules are checked by POST /api/decks/validate.

public.description: A public deck can be read by everyone; a private one only by its owner.

hidden.description:
Set by the moderators: a hidden deck is no longer shown publicly (its owner still sees it). Only an
administrator can change it.

cards.description: Writing the cards replaces the whole list.

tags.name: CollectionItem
tags.description:
A line of the collection of a player: copies of one print of a card (its extension and its rarity) in a given
condition, language and edition. Copies in another condition are another line; a graded card (company, grade,
optional certificate number) has no condition and is a line of its own, one copy per line.

The collection is private unless its owner made it public (User::collectionPublic).
